title: Brown Mock-Neck & Leather Mini
prompt: A three-quarter fashion portrait of an original young woman with long, soft blonde waves and blunt bangs, standing against a soft, muted gray backdrop. She wears a fitted chocolate-brown mock-neck long-sleeved top with an asymmetric hem that dips toward one side and slightly gathered waist. Beneath it, a dark brown embossed leather mini skirt with a floral pattern, a silver western-style belt buckle, and sheer black tights. She holds a bundle of dried flowers in one hand, low by her side. Her expression is calm, with her gaze turned to the left. Soft, diffused natural light with gentle shadows, a muted palette of chocolate, espresso, and warm gray with silver accents. Editorial, understated, and slightly romantic, in the style of a contemporary fall fashion editorial.
workingNotes:
- The asymmetric hem and embossed leather are the key details; keep both.
- The dried flowers add a soft counterpoint to the leather; drop them for a sharper look.
tryThis: Try this: Drop the dried flowers for a sharper look.
